title: Settings
description: Configure model credentials and market data source tokens for this local project.

localApiAccess.title: Local API access
localApiAccess.description: For remote or private Web UI deployments, enter the server API key once in this browser. Localhost use can stay blank.
localApiAccess.placeholder: Stored only in this browser. Leave blank to clear it.
localApiAccess.storedNote: Stored only in this browser. Leave blank to clear it.

llmSettings.title: LLM Settings
llmSettings.description: Choose the model used by the agent and save it to the project-local agent/.env file.
llmSettings.providerHint: Changing providers updates the recommended model and endpoint.
llmSettings.modelHint: Use the exact model id required by your provider.
llmSettings.reasoningHint: How hard the model thinks before answering. Higher is more thorough but slower; leave Off for fastest replies.

dataSource.title: Data Source Settings
dataSource.description: Configure optional market data credentials used by backtests and research agents.
dataSource.tushareHint: Used for China A-share, futures, fund, and macro data. If unset, the project falls back to AKShare where available.

toast.dataSaveFailed: Failed to save data source settings
